name: console-chat-picker-frame
goal: Keep the console chat visible when its model and effort pickers are open

evidence: The model and effort dialogs crop the Console Chat panel and launcher from their screenshots; the full component must remain visible.
The component catalog checked that dialogs opened but did not assert that capture bounds include the panel and launcher. Its shared state action now checks both.
At b04edffba31a the desktop model-open catalog test failed because its capture bounds excluded the chat panel.
Frame both fixed chat surfaces when a console model or effort picker is open.
